entries.title: Psalms 98:1
segments: <<A Psalm.>> Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.

entries.title: Psalms 98:2
segments: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 98:3
segments: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 98:4
segments: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

entries.title: Psalms 98:5
segments: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.

entries.title: Psalms 98:6
segments: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 98:7
segments: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;

entries.title: Psalms 98:8
segments: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together

entries.title: Psalms 98:9
segments: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
